tasks.title: Project scaffolding & documentation
tasks.details: Create tasks.json and context/ docs on project root so any LLM session can resume. Context docs: overview, requirements, architecture, UI design, PWA, storage, reminders, timesheet, status log.

tasks.title: Rebrand & redesign UI as a professional tool
tasks.details: Rename system to 'DSR Mail Generator'. New professional theme (Inter font, slate/indigo). App shell with sidebar navigation: Daily Status (DSR) page and Timesheet page. Keep existing DSR features (Today / This Week / Custom Range, exclude dates, per-day inputs, same-activity, validation, Gmail draft generation).

tasks.title: PWA support
tasks.details: vite-plugin-pwa: manifest (name 'DSR Mail Generator', standalone display, indigo theme), service worker (autoUpdate, offline cache of app shell), app icons (192, 512, maskable 512, apple-touch 180, favicon), theme-color meta.

tasks.title: Local persistence (localStorage)
tasks.details: Persist daily status report history keyed by date (YYYY-MM-DD) so the timesheet can be built from it. Also persist reminder schedule, draft settings, and timesheet profile.

tasks.title: Reminder / scheduling engine
tasks.details: Recurring reminders: every Friday 18:00 (DSR) and every 2nd of month 18:00 (timesheet). After each fires, advance to next occurrence (next Friday; next month's 2nd). Use Notifications API (in-app + SW) and provide .ics export to import into phone calendar so the reminder also lands on the phone.

tasks.title: Timesheet generator (monthly)
tasks.details: Template from 'Timesheet september 2026 (1).xlsx'. Keep top section (Name, Title, Department, Reporting Head, Client, Project, Location). Regenerate day rows for the selected month: Date, Day, Time In / Time Out (defaults), Billable Hours default '8 hours' (0 for leave dates), Non-billable and Comments empty, Work Activities pulled from submitted DSR history. Output .xlsx via xlsx-js-style. Email: To accounts@mobileprogramming.com, CC rohit.dudani@programming.com + suraksha.devadiga@programming.com, subject 'Timesheet Submission - Siemens - Raviraj Bugge - MM-YY', body per user-provided text.

tasks.title: DSR history wiring
tasks.details: When DSR drafts are generated, save each day's activity into history store so the timesheet can reference them.

tasks.title: Build, typecheck, PWA verification
tasks.details: vite build, tsc --noEmit, dev-server smoke test, verify manifest + service worker register and offline caching.

constraints: Gmail compose URLs cannot attach files - timesheet is downloaded as .xlsx and attached manually by the user in the opened Gmail draft.
True background scheduling on a phone requires native calendar/push; .ics export + in-app notifications are the supported mechanisms here.
Web worker / periodic background sync has limited support; reminders are evaluated while the PWA is open and on launch.
decisions: Storage: localStorage (simple, synchronous, sufficient for text-sized data).
Excel generation: xlsx-js-style for styled output (SheetJS community drops styles).
Navigation: hand-rolled manifest-driven path router (no react-router). Superseded the earlier state-based switching; see hive/board.md.
Reminder scheduling: self-rescheduling computed events persisted in localStorage, Notifications API, plus .ics import for phone.
